failure_modes.evidence: While we cannot confirm target engagement or pathway modulation due to lack of biomarker data, the complete lack of PFS benefit (HR 0.906, p=0.492) suggests that even if sorafenib engaged its targets, the assumed biology (enhanced cytotoxicity through angiogenesis inhibition) did not translate to clinical benefit in melanoma
